snippet.title: Beta 0.02 Update Now Live!
snippet.description:
RECOIL: DIGITAKILL - Official Beta Trailer 💥🎮Welcome to Neon Dream Studio. Games for everyone.Recoil: Digitakill is a fast-paced, high-octane FPS movement-roguelike inspired by Ultrakill and The Binding of Isaac.The main mechanic? Your primary weapon is a FINGER GUN with insane recoil that boosts your speed, allowing you to slide, fly across the arena, and pull off crazy movement combos while blasting digital cubes and spheres under heavy beats.Clear wave after wave, unlock chests, and stack crazy random card synergies: x2 damage, explosive bullets, ricochet, and pure speed buffs!👾 WANT TO PLAY THE BETA FIRST? JOIN THE DISCORD! 👾


Join the community here: discord.gg/9nmQtR2v6b
Ready?
